expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner uses white text on a pale mint green background. The headline, subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') fail contrast requirements and are barely readable.

The 'Fastest near you' carousel's third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is cut flush against the right screen edge — image, title and delivery price are all sliced with no gutter, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
The category chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy, …') is also clipped at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.

Favourite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular background with dark outline, while the pizza card below uses a dark translucent circle with white outline.
The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly truncated by the bottom navigation bar with no card metadata visible, and the divider above the tab bar cuts through the image.

expected.reasoning: Issue 0 directly describes the promo banner with white text on pale mint background failing contrast and being unreadable.
